join hortbot 99 foobar 1

twitch_get_channel_by_id {"ID": 1, "Channel": {"game_name": ""}}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_GAME_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add testclean (_GAME_CLEAN_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] (Not set)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testclean
send hortbot #foobar [HB] -Not-set-


twitch_get_channel_by_id {"ID": 1, "Channel": {"game_name": "Somebody's weird 世界 game: 2"}}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Somebody's weird 世界 game: 2

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testclean
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Somebody-s-weird----game--2


twitch_get_channel_by_id {"ID": 1, "Err": "ErrServerError"}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testclean
send hortbot #foobar [HB] -error-


twitch_get_channel_by_id {"ID": 1, "Err": "ErrNotAuthorized"}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testclean
send hortbot #foobar [HB] -error-
